description.value: Red Chairs is part of Parks Canada's signature program placing iconic red Adirondack-style chairs at scenic viewpoints throughout Canada's national parks, inviting visitors to pause and take in the landscape. This location sits within Kootenay National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site spanning glacially carved valleys, dramatic canyons, and fire-influenced grasslands along the historic Banff–Windermere Highway. For touring cyclists riding through the Rockies, it represents a photo-worthy and contemplative stop amid outstanding mountain scenery.
